column1: # Real rows of two nf-core/rnasplice runs; source files: see README.md in this directory. The column fixture names the fixture directory.
# real_testdata: the nf-core test-data run (contrast GBR_vs_YRI, treatment GBR, control YRI).
# real_hipscm: the human hiPSC-CM run of 2026-10-06 (contrast KO_vs_WT, treatment KO, control WT, 3 vs 3); every row is in the trimmed tables of real_hipscm/.

# expected_sign is the sign of the harmonised treatment-minus-control effect, derived from the rule in the column rule; the column verification says how the sign of the row was checked against the data.

# real_testdata edgeR: the test data have 0 exon rows at FDR < 0.05 and 2 at FDR < 0.5; those 2 are used, and the third row (FDR 0.9999) is included only because it is the first row with a negative logFC.
# real_testdata rMATS, DEXSeq exon, DEXSeq DTU: rows with FDR/padj < 0.05. SUPPA2 has no adjusted p-value: rows with p-val < 0.05.
# SUPPA2: the column name local_KO-local_WT_dPSI reads like KO minus WT, but the rule is flip: dPSI is control minus treatment (spec section 5), so the harmonised effect is -dPSI.
